Michael Ingram is a Senior Contributor from the United States of America. Michael has been writing for GameRant since 2021, writing both analytically and fiction for years beforehand. Michael is a lifelong gamer whose first memories with video games come from being a four-year-old playing Sonic the Hedgehog on his brother's Sega Genesis and Pokemon Red on his Game Boy Color. He is a noted RPG buff who lists some of his favorite franchises as Persona, Tales, and Fire Emblem. Alongside his lifelong love for video games, Michael is a passionate fan of anime, hockey, and card games, particularly Yu-Gi-Oh. Michael has over 1,000 hours on Yu-Gi-Oh Master Duel on Steam alone and over 300 hours on Magic: The Gathering Arena. 4. Michael is also a Level 1-certified judge for the Yu-Gi-Oh Trading Card Game and the Pokemon Trading Card Game. Michael is also an avid hobby writer, regularly posting his fiction to his "lordtakuro" Twitter page . Michael has written a full novel, currently in the post-writing stage, and is in the process of writing his second.
Michael lists his Top 5 favorite games as Genshin Impact, Persona 4 Golden, Tales of Symphonia, The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask, and Phoenix Wright - Ace Attorney: Trials and Tribulations. Michael has been a lifelong fan of RPGs with fleshed-out and engaging stories. He is also a particularly big fan of Hoyoverse's many games for their engaging gameplay, interesting worldbuilding, and amazing art and music.
Michael's proudest achievement as a gamer comes from his time playing mobile rhythm game Love Live! School Idol Festival. During Michael's time seriously playing the game in 2015 and 2016, he became a hardcore player of many of the game's regularly-occuring events, frequently placing in the Top 500 rankings for multiple events.
Michael is primarily focused on breaking news in the world of gaming, aiming to cover everything from new announcements to leaks. Michael particularly specializes in the gacha gaming and collectible card games genres, often keeping a close eye on new and upcoming releases in both.
